title: Zesty Light Croatian Turkey Ham Wrap
description: A refreshing and light Croatian dish featuring turkey ham, wrapped in a corn husk and cooked to perfection in a bain-marie, perfect for a springtime snack or lunch
instructions: Preheat the bain-marie to 180 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, whisk together the white wine, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Add the chopped parsley to the bowl and stir to combine
Lay a corn husk flat on a work surface and arrange 2 slices of turkey ham in the center
Brush the wine and parsley mixture evenly over the turkey ham
Fold the corn husk over the filling to form a wrap and secure with a toothpick if needed
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients
Place the wraps in the preheated bain-marie and cook for 10 minutes
Remove the wraps from the bain-marie and let cool for 2 minutes before serving
